page: Microsoft Azure L80as_v3 is a high-capacity server instance belonging to the LASv3 family, utilizing x86_64 AMD processors. The system is configured with 80 dedicated virtual CPUs and 640.0 GB of system memory, which establishes a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, ensuring dedicated compute allocation without shared-core resource contention.

A primary feature of this instance is its storage configuration. It comes equipped with 20,019 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, designed to support high-throughput and low-latency data access. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage volumes. No graphics processing units are included in this hardware profile.

Given the combination of 80 dedicated cores, a large memory footprint, and over 20 TB of local NVMe storage, this instance is structured for data-dense operations. It is highly suitable for large-scale relational databases, NoSQL platforms, data warehousing, big data analytics, and transactional workloads that require substantial local storage capacity and high memory-to-core ratios.
description: Microsoft Azure L80as_v3 is a storage-optimized instance from the LASv3 family, featuring 80 dedicated AMD vCPUs on an x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with 640.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core, and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The server is characterized by its massive 20,019 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and its Premium Storage compatibility. Lacking integrated GPUs, this instance is designed to deliver high qualitative cost efficiency for memory-heavy and storage-intensive workloads. It is particularly suited for large-scale databases, data warehousing, and big data analytics.
